subject: Copywriting
title: Robert Collier: The Letter Book
description: A micro-lesson that makes Robert Collier: The Letter Book usable.

hook.text: Robert Collier sold books, mining shares, and self-help courses by mail in the 1930s.

buildup.text: Collier said great copy enters the conversation already happening in the reader's mind. Don't start fresh—join in.

discovery.text: His 'Robert Collier Letter Book' compiled hundreds of real letters with results. Each was a case study in persuasion.

twist.text: Collier was a spiritual writer too, blending metaphysics with marketing. An unusual combination that worked.

climax.text: His principle—meet readers where they are, not where you are—is the foundation of modern customer journey mapping.

punchline.text: Enter their conversation. Don't start your own. Join in.

quiz.question: What was Robert Collier's key copywriting principle?
options: Enter the conversation already in the reader's mind
